details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:1045-1103 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The success-no-op regex is overly broad and can falsely match unrelated Codex output, causing incorrect issue closure.
  WHY: Multiple reviewers flagged the same root cause; one reviewer cited line 1045 while others cited line 1103, so the merged range spans both claims.
- .github/workflows/validate.yml:483 | severity=medium | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, minimax_minimax-m2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The pip install step suppresses output with `--quiet` while also tolerating failure, making dependency-install problems hard to diagnose.
  WHY: Reviewers agreed the install can fail silently and leave later template-mode failures unexplained.
- scripts/review_consolidate.sh:67-88 | severity=medium | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: Temporary files are created before the cleanup trap is installed, so early exits can leak `/tmp` artifacts.
  WHY: All reviewers identified the same trap-ordering race; one reviewer explicitly noted the trap is installed after `mkdir -p` / `mktemp -d`.
- scripts/review_consolidate.sh:97-106 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: When the expected config files are missing, the reasoning setting is silently omitted and the consolidator falls back to defaults.
  WHY: Two reviewers flagged missing-config handling; one considered it already addressed, so the merged severity uses the highest shared claim and notes the disagreement.
- scripts/review_consolidate.sh:100-103 | severity=medium | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: `REVIEW_CONSOLIDATOR_REASONING` is interpolated into `sed` without escaping, so special characters can break the substitution or corrupt the TOML.
  WHY: All reviewers except one independently identified the same unescaped-sed failure mode; one reviewer treated it as a remaining issue while others listed it as a primary finding.
- scripts/review_consolidate.sh:102 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3-flash-preview]
  PROBLEM: `sed -i` is GNU-specific and may fail on non-Linux systems that require a suffix argument.
  WHY: Only one reviewer reported this portability issue, and no other reviewer corroborated it.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:1103 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Overly broad success-no-op regex can cause false positives.
  WHY: The case-insensitive pattern can match common phrases in Codex output and incorrectly close the issue as `ai:closed`.
- .github/workflows/validate.yml:483 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Silent pip install failures with `--quiet` flag.
  WHY: `--quiet` plus `continue-on-error: true` can hide network, permission, or package errors and make failures hard to diagnose.
- scripts/review_consolidate.sh:67-88 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Temporary files created before cleanup trap is installed.
  WHY: `mktemp` creates `tmp_out`, `tmp_err`, and `tmp_cap` before the trap is set, so an early exit leaks them.
- scripts/review_consolidate.sh:100-102 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `REVIEW_CONSOLIDATOR_REASONING` variable not escaped in sed command.
  WHY: Direct interpolation of `/`, `&`, `\`, or quotes can fail or produce malformed TOML, and `|| true` masks the error.
- scripts/review_consolidate.sh:98-106 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Missing config files handled silently.
  WHY: If `CODEX_HOME` is unset or config files are missing, the requested reasoning level is omitted and the consolidator uses defaults.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===
- scripts/review_consolidate.sh:67-88 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Temporary files `tmp_out`, `tmp_err`, `tmp_cap` are created before the cleanup trap is installed.
  WHY: If `mkdir -p` or `mktemp -d` fails under `set -e`, the script exits before the trap exists and leaks the temp files.
- scripts/review_consolidate.sh:99-106 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `REVIEW_CONSOLIDATOR_REASONING` is embedded into `sed` without escaping.
  WHY: Characters like `/` or `&` can break the substitution or produce malformed output, and `|| true` hides the failure.
- scripts/review_consolidate.sh:92 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: If `CODEX_HOME` is unset or empty, the copy step may attempt to copy from root or otherwise fail into an empty overlay.
  WHY: The consolidator can then run with zero configuration and likely fail to authenticate or locate models.
- scripts/review_consolidate.sh:102 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The use of `sed -i` without a suffix is GNU-specific.
  WHY: The command works on Linux but fails on macOS or BSD unless `sed -i ''` is used.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:1045 | severity=medium | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Success-no-op detection regex is very broad and might match log text from unrelated failures.
  WHY: The pattern can trigger on incidental phrasing such as “we have already implemented this feature,” leading to a false close.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- scripts/review_consolidate.sh:67-88 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The temp files are created before the cleanup trap is installed.
  WHY: If `mkdir -p` or `mktemp -d` fails under `set -e`, the earlier temp files leak.
- scripts/review_consolidate.sh:100-110 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `${REVIEW_CONSOLIDATOR_REASONING}` is embedded directly into the `sed` replacement without escaping metacharacters.
  WHY: Characters like `/`, `&`, and `\` will break the substitution or produce malformed TOML.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:1103 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The success-no-op regex can match unrelated phrases in Codex output and incorrectly trigger success detection.
  WHY: The pattern is broad enough to catch common language such as “already implemented,” causing false positives.
- .github/workflows/validate.yml:322 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The validation template dependency install suppresses diagnostics and tolerates failure.
  WHY: `--quiet` plus `continue-on-error` can hide install problems and make later failures hard to interpret.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- scripts/review_consolidate.sh:100-103 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `REVIEW_CONSOLIDATOR_REASONING` is embedded directly into the `sed` replacement pattern without escaping.
  WHY: Special characters like `&`, `/`, `\`, or newline can corrupt the config or make `sed` fail, and the failure is masked by `|| true`.
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM stepfun_step-3_5-flash ===
- scripts/review_consolidate.sh:67-88 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Temp files are created before the cleanup trap, creating a leak window.
  WHY: Under `set -e`, failure in setup before the trap is installed leaves `tmp_out`, `tmp_err`, and `tmp_cap` behind.
- scripts/review_consolidate.sh:100-102 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `REVIEW_CONSOLIDATOR_REASONING` is interpolated into `sed` without escaping metacharacters.
  WHY: `/`, `&`, `\`, or newline can corrupt the TOML or make `sed` fail, and `|| true` hides the failure.
- scripts/review_consolidate.sh:97-106 | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When config files are missing, the reasoning level is silently omitted.
  WHY: If neither config file exists, the consolidator runs with default reasoning instead of the intended configured value.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:1089-1095 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The success-no-op regex can false-positive on incidental phrasing in Codex output.
  WHY: The pattern matches common English text unless anchored more tightly to known success signals.
- .github/workflows/validate.yml:483 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The pip install step suppresses failure output.
  WHY: Quiet install plus `continue-on-error` obscures dependency-install problems and makes later template failures hard to debug.
=== END FINDINGS FROM stepfun_step-3_5-flash ===
